thread:
mai: Quick thread to lock FleetLock onboarding gates. We need final bench thresholds, pin-tier semantics, and a simple pricing sketch for pilots by EOD.
rory: High level: bench parity + stability gates, clear pin windows, and an automatic fallback policy. Propose p95 <= 300ms seq256 hosted, p95 <= 180ms on Dedicated.
gena: ML bench details: embedding R@10 >= 0.9 on our retrieval slice; dialog factuality errors <= 2.2% on QA set; rerank MRR +5% over baseline. Include adversarial set.
victor: Ops: pin tiers impose capacity reservations. Suggest tiers:
- trial: 7d soft-pin (no reservation)
- standard: 45d managed-pin (+18% reserved uplift)
- enterprise: 120d contract-pin (+32% reserved uplift)
Enterprise pins require manual ops approval and lead time for capacity.
lina: Product: customers asked for explicit notice windows. For contract-pin, commit to no forced migrations during the 120d window and 30d notice afterwards. For managed-pin, 14d notice.
rory: Rollout plan idea:
1) bench CI on seq64/256 -> pass
2) internal canary (2 days)
3) invited pilot customers (sampled traffic, 7 days)
4) expand cohort
Code snippet for bench command:
```
# bench_fleetlock.sh
python bench.py --model fleetlock-v1 --seq 256 --runs 500 --suites seed,adv --metrics p95,embed_r10,mrr,factual_err
```
mai: Pricing ask from marketing: need per-month pin add-on and per-token uplift. Provide conservative COGS to finance.
finance-bot: Preliminary COGS calc: baseline unit $0.30/1k tokens. With 32% reserved uplift for enterprise pin -> effective COGS $0.396/1k. Recommend pilot markup 2.0x. Need expected volumes to finalize.
gena: Instrumentation: tag every request with model, model_version, pin_tier, quant_variant, seq_bucket, migration_id. Also emit "halluc_flag" for QA slice.
victor: Fallback policy: if p95 or error-rate regresses >12% vs baseline for >2h, auto-fallback to last-stable or fleetlock-lite, notify pager and product. Ops runbook must include rollback checklist and telecom matrix.
lina: Comms: I will draft a one-page pre-onboard that lists tiers, expected metrics, and rollback behavior. Pilot invites should include opt-in for pin-tier.
rory: Who owns what: gena -> bench harness + adversarial sets, victor -> capacity calc + runbook, lina -> comms + pilot invites, mai -> pilot timeline + invite list, finance-bot -> final pricing table.
mai: Target: lock thresholds and tiers by Fri so we can open invites Monday.
finance-bot: I'll mock a pricing table with 3 scenarios once I have per-customer volume estimates.
gena: I'll push bench PR today, include scripts and dataset pointers.
victor: I'll draft the fallback runbook and a quick playbook for performing manual pin approvals.
lina: Draft comms in #product-comms by tomorrow AM.
mai: Thanks team. If no objections I'll post the pilot invite with the current plan on Monday and tag owners. :rocket:
